name: 02903 · Providence, RI
findings: ZIP 02903 (Providence) has 314 nonprofit organizations. 116 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 104 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02903 (Providence) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 02903 (Providence) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 6.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
